mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,crmp_periodo as timeFrame ,(select cptm_codigo from account.periodotiempo_ptm where cptm_llave = crmp_periodo) as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,drmp_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crmp_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crmp_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drmp_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crmp_estado as state from x_${catalog}_${type}_rmp inner join cuenta_cue on (ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta)
mapper.select: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,ccue_nombre as accountName ,ccue_codigo as accountCode ,crmp_periodo as timeFrame ,(select cptm_codigo from account.periodotiempo_ptm where cptm_llave = crmp_periodo) as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,drmp_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crmp_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crmp_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drmp_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crmp_estado as state from account.cuenta_cue left join account.periodotiempo_ptm on ( nptm_nivel = 0) left join account.maparesultados_rmp on (crmp_cuenta = ccue_llave and crmp_periodo = cptm_llave) where ccue_catalogo = '${catalogId}' and ncue_nivel = 1 and ccue_estado = 'A' order by ccue_wbs

select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_cuenta as account ,crmp_periodo as timeFrame ,(select cptm_codigo from account.periodotiempo_ptm where cptm_llave = crmp_periodo) as timeFrameName ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_promedio as average ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_saldosiguiente as nextBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value from account.maparesultados_rmp inner join account.periodotiempo_ptm on ( crmp_periodo = cptm_llave) where crmp_cuenta = '${accountId}' and (nptm_nivel = 0 or (nptm_nivel = 1 and nptm_ano = ${year}) or (nptm_nivel = 2 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month}) or (nptm_nivel = 3 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day}) or (nptm_nivel = 4 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day} and nptm_hora = ${hour}) or (nptm_nivel = 5 and nptm_ano = ${year} and nptm_mes = ${month} and nptm_dia = ${day} and nptm_hora = ${hour} and nptm_minuto = ${minute}) )

update account.maparesultados_rmp set drmp_modificacionfecha = now(), nrmp_cantidad = #{item.quantity}, nrmp_promedio = #{item.average}, mrmp_positivo = #{item.positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{item.negative}, mrmp_valor = #{item.value}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = #{item.nextBalance} where crmp_llave =#{item.key}

INSERT INTO account.maparesultados_rmp (crmp_llave, crmp_cuenta, crmp_periodo) select replace((md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text)::uuid)::text, '-',''), #{accountId}, cptm_llave from account.periodotiempo_ptm where nptm_nivel = 0 or (nptm_nivel = 1 and dptm_fechainicio >= #{startDateYear} and dptm_fechainicio <= #{endDateYear}) or (nptm_nivel = 2 and dptm_fechainicio >= #{startDateMonth} and dptm_fechainicio <= #{endDateMonth}) or (nptm_nivel = 3 and dptm_fechainicio >= #{startDateDay} and dptm_fechainicio <= #{endDateDay})

update account.maparesultados_rmp set mrmp_saldoanterior = mrmp_saldoanterior + #{value}, mrmp_saldosiguiente = mrmp_saldosiguiente + #{value} where crmp_cuenta = #{accountId} and crmp_estado = 'A' and crmp_periodo in ( select cptm_llave from account.periodotiempo_ptm where nptm_nivel = #{level} and dptm_fechainicio > #{startDate})

select cuenta.ccue_llave as key ,cuenta.ccue_catalogo as catalog ,cuenta.dcue_fechainicial as initialDate ,cuenta.dcue_fechafinal as finalDate ,ccue_nombre as name from account.cuenta_cue cuenta inner join account.catalogo_ctg catalogo on (catalogo.cctg_llave = cuenta.ccue_catalogo and catalogo.cctg_estado= 'A') where cuenta.ccue_estado = 'A' and ( cuenta.dcue_fechainicial is null or cuenta.dcue_fechafinal is null or cuenta.dcue_fechainicial > catalogo.dctg_fechainicial or cuenta.dcue_fechafinal < catalogo.dctg_fechafinal ) order by cuenta.ccue_wbs limit 500;
